defect_corrected: the superseded probe passed the adversary's physical speed capability into the model as its observed s0; because r_det is monotone increasing in s0 this raised the model bound in step with the adversary and reported escape=0 at every speed. It also swept only t<=3.0 s and derived a degenerate min_max_speed_for_validity field.

semantics.s0_observed_speed_mps: |v0| of the Kalman state at the track's last real observation; a MODEL INPUT, entering both the CV nominal p0+v0*t and the deviation cap |v(s)-v0| <= max_speed + s0
semantics.configured_max_speed_mps: bounds.max_speed, a configuration constant (production 0.8); a MODEL ASSUMPTION, never compared against the track's own measured speed anywhere in reachability.hpp or the tracker
semantics.v_phys_capability_mps: the obstacle's true future speed ceiling; a property of the PHYSICAL WORLD, independent of s0 and of the configured value, and not represented anywhere in the shipped code
semantics.total_time_s: observation_age + horizon, the t of r_det(t); production admits up to 4.0 s (max_observation_age 1.0 + horizon 3.0)
semantics.model_bound_m: r_det(t) = reachRadius(t, s0, configured bounds) -- the DETERMINISTIC term the robot actually uses
semantics.true_reach_m: sup |d(t)| over trajectories with |a|<=a_max and |v|<=v_phys, i.e. the same closed form with v_phys in place of the configured max_speed; Part A verifies it is attained
semantics.escape_m: max(0, true_reach_m - model_bound_m), measured against the deterministic term ALONE; the published region additionally carries the statistical term k*sqrt(lambda), so this is the stricter reading
semantics.guarantee_condition: r_det is an outer bound iff BOTH |a|<=a_max AND |v|<=configured max_speed hold; the second premise is what makes |v(s)-v0| <= max_speed+s0 valid

integrator.scheme: trapezoidal on velocity, exact on linear segments; error is the single clamp kink inside one step

partA_true_reach_is_the_closed_form.claim: sup|d(t)| under (|a|<=a_max, |v|<=v_phys) equals int_0^t min(a_max*s, v_phys+s0) ds, attained by the 1-D full-reversal maneuver

partE_min_configured_max_speed_for_conta.definition: smallest bounds.max_speed for which the model bound contains the true reachable deviation at every total_time in (0,T], given observed speed s0 and physical capability v_phys
partE_min_configured_max_speed_for_conta.replaces: min_max_speed_for_validity, which was degenerate (required = v_true by construction, 0.2500 m at every row) and is not retained
partE_min_configured_max_speed_for_conta.rows_note: rows listed for T = 4.0 s, the full production window; T = 2.0 and 3.0 were also bisected and agreed with the closed form

monotonicity_implication: an OVER-estimated filtered speed only enlarges the bound, so estimation overshoot is conservative, not a violation. This is also precisely why the superseded probe could not detect under-coverage: feeding the adversary's capability in as s0 inflated the bound in step with the threat.
